title: Chapter 379 Democracy
content:
Chapter 379 Democracy

Wang Shuo ordered his men to bring the sand table to the center of the crowd.

"Everyone, come and see the terrain where we will fight."

The entire area is in a triangular shape.

The three forces are distributed in three corners, and each area is connected by several passages.

In the middle is a vast forest.

At the top is the area where the earth mother insects are most concentrated.

Wang Shuo's position is in the lower left corner, but it is already very close to the forest in the middle.

The position is actually not good.

As long as the opponent launches a large-scale attack, his position will bear the brunt.

"Everyone, I want to remind you that as long as the other side breaks through this main base, we will lose this battle."

"Now, I am worried about two things. One is whether the Earth Mother Worm will take the initiative to attack, and the other is, what will happen to us if we lose this battle?"

At this time, Tian Liang said: "Commander, I can answer these two questions for you. As long as we don't go deep into the ultimate nest of the Earth Mother Worm, the Earth Mother Worm will not come out in full force to attack our base. But the ultimate boss of the Earth Mother Worm has a very important prop. If we can get it, it will be of great help to this battle."

"The second question is that if you die in this battle, you will become a summoned general. Otherwise, where do the generals we summon come from?"

Everyone swallowed unconsciously.

"If the battle fails, but you don't die, then the general will have a chance to participate in the next round of battles. Each general has only three chances. If they fail three times, they will still become tools."

Tian Liang's answer answered many people's doubts.

"How many of you here have been the third time?"

Wang Shuo wanted to know.

"This is my third time."

"Hey! Me too..."

...

Nearly 10 people admitted that this was their third time to participate in the battle.

In fact, no matter how many times, they should have fought to the death.

After someone expressed his true feelings, everyone seemed to be able to empathize.

At this moment, everyone's hearts seemed to be closer.

"In fact, I want to say that the biggest problem in this battle is that everyone must unite and obey unified command. My previous two failures were caused by disagreements and fighting on their own."

Someone said so.

The generals present all bowed their heads in thought.

Indeed, the generals present would not have a bad command level.

It is precisely because they all think that they can command better that many good ideas have not been implemented.

Wang Shuo looked at the crowd and slowly said: "For this battle, I hope that every decision we make will be voted on by raising hands. After it is decided, everyone must do everything possible to complete it. Do you agree?"

Seeing Wang Shuo so democratic and not dictatorial, everyone felt very comfortable.

Especially for the generals who had experienced battles, it was because the commander directly ordered everyone to do this and that, sacrificing the interests of some people, that the key links went wrong and ultimately failed.

"I agree with this."

...

"Let's raise our hands and vote! If more than half of them agree, the proposal will be passed."

At this time, everyone raised their hands.

But there were still a few who didn't raise their hands.

Wang Shuo looked at the few people who didn't raise their hands and said in a deep voice: "Ladies and gentlemen, I really want to lead everyone to win. None of us are stupid people. If we can't even pass the first resolution, it means that you and we are not of the same mind at all."

"In that case, you can leave on your own! As long as you don't hinder our plan, you and I will be safe!"
